the farm
Visit our farm
our story

Visit our farm.

Shell & Yolk is a small farm with one simple idea: good eggs make better mornings. Come and see where our hens live, what they eat, and how every egg is gathered, checked and packed.

Plan a visitShop eggs
the farm

Happy, roaming hens

Our flock has room to stretch, scratch and sunbathe. Calm hens lay better eggs, so we keep the farm calm.

Gathered fresh

Eggs are collected, checked by hand and packed right here on the farm, then sent straight to your kitchen.

Brown or white, same good egg

The shell colour is just the breed of hen. What is inside is the same golden goodness.

Our story

It started with a handful of hens and a stubborn belief that eggs should taste like they used to. We still do it the same way: feed well, keep things calm, and pack every box ourselves.

Brown eggs, white eggs, boxes of 6, 10 or 12, whichever you pick, it comes from the same flock and the same hands.

Visit us
